title: Shared Accounts with Rc<RefCell>
prompt:
Several owners can hold the same bank account through Rc<RefCell<Account>>. Implement:

- Account::shared(owner, balance) -> Rc<RefCell<Account>>: convenience constructor.
- transfer(from, to, amount) -> Result<(), TransferError>:
    * if from and to are the SAME account (Rc::ptr_eq), return Err(TransferError::SameAccount) without touching anything (borrowing the same RefCell mutably twice would panic!)
    * if amount == 0, return Err(TransferError::ZeroAmount)
    * if from has insufficient funds, return Err(TransferError::Insufficient { needed: amount, available: balance })
    * otherwise move the money and push a log entry to BOTH accounts' history: the sender gets -(amount as i64), the receiver gets +(amount as i64)
- total(accounts: &[Rc<RefCell<Account>>]) -> u64: sum of balances, counting each distinct account only once even if it appears multiple times in the slice (compare with Rc::ptr_eq).

Example:
  let a = Account::shared("ann", 100); let b = Account::shared("bob", 5);
  transfer(&a, &b, 30) -> Ok(()); a.borrow().balance == 70; b.borrow().history == [30]
  total(&[a.clone(), b.clone(), a.clone()]) -> 105
